rules: C ABI synchronous return codes describe submit/argument failure only.
Asynchronous failures are delivered through FlareResultCallback(error, result_json).
FlareError.code is stable. FlareError.message is human-readable and must not be parsed.
details_json is reserved for future structured diagnostics and may be empty.
Platform SDKs must map codes to typed errors instead of string matching messages.

cAbi.errorStruct: FlareError { code: i32, message: FlareString, details_json: FlareString }
cAbi.callback: extern C fn(context, error: *const FlareError, result_json: FlareString)

codes.name: FLARE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM
codes.meaning: invalid pointer, missing field, invalid enum, or invalid argument

codes.name: FLARE_ERR_NOT_CONNECTED
codes.meaning: operation requires a logged-in/connected SDK session

codes.name: FLARE_ERR_TOKEN_EXPIRED
codes.meaning: access token expired; caller should refresh token or relogin

codes.name: FLARE_ERR_INTERNAL
codes.meaning: internal or currently unmapped core error

codes.name: FLARE_ERR_JSON_PARSE
codes.meaning: invalid JSON input or failed JSON serialization

codes.name: FLARE_ERR_FFI_PANIC
codes.meaning: panic was caught at the FFI boundary
